# r/denvernuggets (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Before the season, we put numbers on Nikola Jokić. Here's what we're watching

**Body:**

The season is underway. On October 17, before tip-off, we put three calls on Nikola Jokić's year. Each one gets graded in public.

By our model, Nikola Jokić has been the best player in the league for six straight years. One more would tie Michael Jordan's record. We give it a 55% chance.

His six seasons average an impact of +3.36, above Jordan's +3.17 and LeBron's +3.19. Statistically, the highest run ever measured.

The MVP voters have agreed with our number one only 24 times in 49 seasons. Jokić has lost three of his six. That's normal, not a robbery.

What we said:
55%  He stays #1 in The 644
60%  He leads the NBA in Box Plus/Minus
25%  He wins the 2026–27 MVP

Full piece, from October 17 (free, no ads): https://thegravityreport.com/notes/jokic/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
